items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh I worked with John a many times in the Tulles Cedar band with Papa Southern Stan

ctx.x: I didn't have a lot of time. I didn't have an opportunity to work with him.
Oh boy, he didn't work with Penny since he'd come back. What about John Marrero? I think you mentioned him. Or was it Simon a few minutes? Oh that was John, his brother.
There was two brothers. John, Lance. John, Simon and Lance. All of them was brothers. Eddie? Eddie. You ever work with Eddie?

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Oh I worked with John a many times in the Tulles Cedar band

ctx.x: Did you work with John much you said? Who? With John Marrero.

Oh I worked with John a many times in the Tulles Cedar band with Papa Southern Stan when Ridley was playing tramo. Ridley would get, Ridley would have two jobs like that. He'd give Young Morgan a job and he'd go play with Young Morgan in his band and play with Papa Southern Stan.
Did he like to play with Young Morgan or something?
